title: Trace repair inside the real orchestrator: an end-to-end assembly-v2 run of run_full_evolution.py
hypothesis: Building plateau-triggered expert-trace repair into EvolutionOrchestrator (with task-generic manifests and an expert-demonstration source) makes run_full_evolution.py itself solve assembly-v2, reproducing D-032 without the study-mode emulation.

prediction.against: the same orchestrator run with the trace-repair step disabled (exploration lane v2 only), same seeds and manifests; final incumbents on fresh development cases
prediction.rationale: D-032 emulated the pipeline; this checks the real orchestrator, records and lineage. Two paired runs (repair on/off) per block, two blocks.

protocol.command: python scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/assembly_two_lane_repair.yaml --seed <3900|3910> --log-dir logs/r037/block<A|B>_repair_on [--dev-pool-seed 3912 --demo-pool-seed 3913] and the same with --seed <3901|3911> --repair disabled; then scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py --env-name assembly-v2 --pool-seed <3904|3914> --episodes 30 --frozen <manifest>
code_changes: lares/core/training_pipeline.py (EvolutionOrchestrator: plateau trigger for the exploration lane, trace-repair slot with code-derived lineage)
scripts/run_full_evolution.py (task-generic manifests built from config pool seeds; expert demonstrations for any task in EXPERT_POLICY_MAP)
lares/search/schemas.py, lanes.py (a repair-lane label and its record rules)

falsified_by: An upper paired bound below +0.30 between repair-on and repair-off final incumbents refutes the integrated effect; no plateau trigger in a block leaves it inconclusive for that block.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00065, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation; the advisor reserves the live launch for the user after the mocked gate passes

notes: Across blocks (paired t over the two block differences, n=2): mean 1.000, interval [1.0, 1.0]; both differences are exactly +1.000, so the interval has zero width. With n=2 that is a degenerate interval, not a precise one.

All four runs triggered (24/24 search candidates at 0 probe successes, prefix not promoted). Repair-on: demonstrations 10/10 in both blocks; the trace repair (gen0_cand1, parent gen0_cand0) was promoted at 30/30 on development cases 10-39, paired interval [1,1]. Repair-off: the fresh exploration was not promoted; the final incumbent stayed the null incumbent (0 on every case by definition), so no fresh episodes were run for it.

Spend: 1440 simulator episodes (cap 1660) and 8 gpt-6.1-sol calls (cap 40); per run 350 (on) / 340 (off) episodes, 2 calls each, no validity correction needed. Accounting: {"A_on": {"learner_episodes": {"screen": 40, "probe": 240, "expanded": 60}, "demonstration_episodes": 10, "episodes_total": 350, "llm_calls": 2, "llm_tokens": 23927}, "A_off": {"learner_episodes": {"screen": 40, "probe": 240, "expanded": 60}, "demonstration_episodes": 0, "episodes_total": 340, "llm_calls": 2, "llm_tokens": 17771}, "B_on": {"learner_episodes": {"screen": 40, "probe": 240, "expanded": 60}, "demonstration_episodes": 10, "episodes_total": 350, "llm_calls": 2, "llm_tokens": 29210}, "B_off": {"learner_episodes": {"screen": 40, "probe": 240, "expanded": 60}, "demonstration_episodes": 0, "episodes_total": 340, "llm_calls": 2, "llm_tokens": 16291}}.

Traceability: every record of the four runs verifies (lineage, prompts, states, reconstruction) when checked on the GPU box that produced them; on the Mac, reconstruction reports 'actions differ', a cross-platform float difference, not a provenance gap.
Fresh manifests 3904/3914 were frozen before any run (config/manifests/r037), rebuilt and matched at scoring time (--frozen), and scored only after both incumbents of their block were fixed.

Deviations: seeds and manifests were reserved/frozen before research.py start, so the idea file was reconciled (protocol.seeds empty, manifests listed) per advisor call_00066 option A. Block B's repair-off run failed to launch once (shell precedence; no work done) and was relaunched with the identical command.
Each block pairs one repair-on with one repair-off run; evaluation cases are not independent search replicates (call_00065). The unit of replication is the block, n=2.

verdicts.reasoning: Both blocks triggered (all 24 prefix candidates at 0 probe successes, nothing promoted), and in both the integrated trace repair became the final incumbent through the unchanged strict promotion rule and scored 30/30 on frozen fresh cases against the repair-off null incumbent's 0/30: block differences +1.000 and +1.000, far above the +0.30 threshold. The real orchestrator, records and lineage reproduce D-032 with full traceability, 1440 episodes and 8 calls. Limits: n=2 blocks, so the zero-width across-block interval is degenerate; one task (assembly-v2); the repair-off arm never promotes anything, so the control is effectively the null incumbent.
verdicts.next_experiment: Make plateau-triggered trace repair available as a standard pipeline option, then test it on a second plateau task once one is found (D-031 found none among shelf-place, basketball and soccer); or test whether the trigger stays silent and costless on tasks that are not plateaus.

verdicts.reasoning: Repair-on achieved 30/30 fresh-development successes in each block [logs/r037/blockA_fresh/confirmation_s3904.json; logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json]. However, the repair-off fresh scores were assigned as zero by the null-incumbent convention, without executing fresh control episodes, so the prediction's named fresh-case control was not measured [logs/r037/blockA_fresh/confirmation_s3904.json; logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json]. Consequently, the reported paired_success_difference of +1.00 mechanically exceeds the +0.30 threshold but does not establish that contrast against a measured control [logs/r037/blockA_fresh/confirmation_s3904.json; logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json]. Plateau triggering occurred in both repair-on blocks, so the unresolved issue is control measurement rather than failure to activate repair [logs/r037/blockA_repair_on/gen_0/plateau_repair.json; logs/r037/blockB_repair_on/gen_0/plateau_repair.json].
verdicts.next_experiment: Using scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py with config/assembly_two_lane_repair.yaml, score both blocks' fixed final incumbents, including an executed null control, on new frozen development manifests with unspent seeds 3920/3921 and 30 cases each (120 simulator episodes, 0 LLM calls); this closes the unmeasured-control gap, with falsified_by defined as a paired_success_difference upper interval bound below +0.30 versus repair-off.

verdicts.reasoning: Answering the advisor's objection that the control was assigned, not measured: after recording, I ran every repair-off candidate (both slots per block, at their searched selected states, no selection) on the same frozen fresh cases: 0/30 for all four (blockA_fresh_control, blockB_fresh_control; 120 episodes, 0 calls, total 1560 <= 1660). The repair-off final incumbent is the null incumbent precisely because neither candidate cleared promotion, and the measured candidates confirm it scores 0 on fresh cases. The repair-on final incumbents scored 30/30 in each block, so the paired fresh-case difference is +1.000 against the null incumbent and against the best measured repair-off candidate in both blocks, far above +0.30. Both blocks triggered; records verify. Limits: n=2 blocks (degenerate zero-width across-block interval), one task.
verdicts.next_experiment: Make plateau-triggered trace repair a standard pipeline option; check the trigger stays silent and costless on non-plateau tasks; look for a second plateau task.

verdicts.reasoning: [revised after review] The newly reported executed controls—all four repair-off candidates scoring 0/30—resolve my substantive objection that the comparison rested only on assigned null scores (implementer's cited artifact: logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json). Repair-on achieved 30/30 in each block, giving paired_success_difference +1.00 against even the measured repair-off candidates, exceeding the specified +0.30 threshold [logs/r037/blockA_fresh/confirmation_s3904.json; logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json]. I therefore withdraw the demand to execute a null incumbent; support remains limited to these two blocks, and their degenerate interval does not establish precise generalization [logs/r037/blockA_fresh/confirmation_s3904.json; logs/r037/blockB_fresh/confirmation_s3914.json].
